Home/Privacy

Privacy, in plain words.

This notice explains what happens to your information when you use the Jarvees Infotech website.

Privacy notice

What we collect

This website does not use cookies, analytics or advertising trackers, and it has no user accounts. Fonts and scripts are served from our own website.

The enquiry form

When you use the enquiry form, your browser assembles your message on your own device. Nothing is sent to or stored on our web server. You then choose how to send it:

  • WhatsApp: the message opens in WhatsApp, addressed to our business number, and is only delivered when you press send.
  • Email: the message opens in your email app, addressed to jarveesacademy.pune@gmail.com, and is only delivered when you press send.

We use the details you send only to reply to your enquiry and to share information about the course or service you asked about. We do not sell or rent personal information.

Third-party services

The contact page embeds a Google Maps view of our office, and links open WhatsApp, Facebook or Google Maps. Those services apply their own privacy policies when you use them.

Your choices

You can ask us to correct or delete the details you have shared with us at any time by calling +91 90225 84956 or emailing jarveesacademy.pune@gmail.com.
